conventionOnly: rawValueRestrictions apply to code written from this repo, not to PageSpecs

overrides.note: PageSpecs carry no per-instance style or token field. Styling is owned by section/component contracts, so there is nothing token-shaped in a PageSpec to validate or mutate.

copyBudgetPolicy.unit: characters (the specs measured c and L, words only occasionally)

rules.max-of-list: measured list of lengths -> the longest
rules.max-of-instances: max over several measured instances of the same slot
rules.spec-sibling: same component, typography and line count as a measured sibling field
rules.clone-implementation-longest: nothing measured: longest original string the clone ships for that slot

copyBudgetPolicy.maxWords: only where the spec measured words (w)

contentPolicy: See assets/asset-roles.json licensingNotice. All copy original; no source-company names, prices, people or marks.
